(Per the Hon'ble the Chief Justice Alok Aradhe)
Mr. Sharad Sanghi, learned counsel for the appellant.
Mr. B.Mayur Reddy, learned Senior Counsel representing Mr. L.Ram Singh, learned counsel for respondent No.1.

Ms. P.Bhavana Rao, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition for respondents No.3 and 4.
2.
With the consent of the parties, the matter is heard finally.

3. This intra court appeal has been filed against the order dated 16.12.2023 passed by the learned Single Judge in W.P.No.33930 of 2023 by which the writ petition filed the respondent No.1 has been disposed of.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is not a party to the writ petition but is entitled to claim compensation under the Award dated 07.10.2023, being the owner of the property bearing H.Nos.2-4-685/1 and 2-4-680/96/1 situated at Sundernagar, Kachiguda,
Hyderabad (hereinafter referred to as, "the subject property").
5.

On the other hand, learned Senior Counsel for the respondent No.1 submits that the appellant has an alternative and efficacious remedy under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as, "the Act"), and the question of title, in any case, cannot be adjudicated in a writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 6. We have considered the rival submissions made on both sides and have perused the record.
7. Admittedly, in respect of the subject property, an award has been passed on 07.10.2023 under the provisions of the Act in favour of the respondent No.1.
In case the appellant has any right, title and interest in the subject property, it is entitled to invoke Section 64 of the Act.

Needless to state that in case any such objection is filed by the appellant under Section 64 of the Act, the same shall be adjudicated in accordance with law after affording an opportunity of hearing to all the necessary parties.
